name: Inquisition learns Saber Slash at 10 and it generates rage (#7194)
contract: Saber Slash (Fire) 680230 is the Inquisition (spec 12) melee generator: SpellFamily 21, melee weapon spell (effect 121 plus triggers 802842 Fiery Judgement and 802007 Wrangler's Net), but its DBC family flags [0,0x10,0] carry no Heartseeking bit and no grant or script binding referenced it. The server teaches it at 10 through the spec-12 taught ability gated on the Flames of Sin identity 92094, binds it to spell_ascension_witch_hunter_ability, and a landed hit casts the energize 500179, whose Effect 0 is ENERGIZE of 99+1 internal rage that the client text shows as $/10;500179s1 = 10 (flag-based Heartseeking matching would also retarget its EFFECT_2 trigger to 807316 in ApplyContracts, so it is matched by spell ID). The level-10 Inquisitor therefore knows the spell after picking the spec, and a landed cast logs exactly one 100-point rage energize regardless of damage dealt.

steps.label: Let login and level scaling settle
Inquisitor knows Saber Slash after picking the spec at 10
SETUP: the Witch Hunter has a Rage pool
Let the weapon swap cooldown expire
Enough rage to pay the cast
Saber Slash lands on the target
Saber Slash generates the 10 rage its tooltip promises whatever it hit for (#8923)
